about.name: Bonheur Nzau
about.bio1: I am a Computer Science student at Université Nouveaux Horizons in Lubumbashi, specializing in Artificial Intelligence. My work bridges intuitive frontends with high-performance backends and resilient system architecture.
about.bio2: My philosophy centers around building practical, accessible digital tools that empower communities. From architecting CampusGuide to streamline higher education interactions, to creating Mikanda to preserve and promote Congolese literature, I focus on software that creates tangible, real-world utility.
about.bio3: Beyond application logic, I am intensely interested in Linux server internals, containerization, computer networking protocols (Cisco CCNA track), and the integration of large language models for smart, automated workflows.

spotlight.label: Spotlight Deep Dive
spotlight.title: CampusGuide: System Architecture & Execution
spotlight.problemDesc: Students face scattered university communication across uncoordinated WhatsApp groups, notice boards, and informal threads, leading to missed mentorship programs, disorganized club activities, and fragmented schedules.
spotlight.solutionDesc: Built an integrated single-page React frontend supported by an Express/Node backend. Implemented normalized relational schemas in MySQL, stateless JWT session authentication, and WebSocket streams for immediate event broadcasts.
spotlight.outcomesDesc: Delivered structured mentorship matchmaking, an organized student club directory, automated push notifications, and verified campus profile management with responsive mobile UX.

caseStudy.label: CASE STUDY BREAKDOWN
caseStudy.title: CampusGuide • In-Depth Architecture
caseStudy.subtitle: Built for Université Nouveaux Horizons Student Ecosystem
highlights: Front-end: Modular React components styled with Tailwind CSS utility classes.
Backend: Express.js routing layer with controllers and service-pattern isolation.
Database: MySQL schema with relational foreign keys for users, clubs, events, and mentorship pairings.
Real-Time: WebSockets (Socket.IO) handling live club broadcasts and instant mentor alerts.
caseStudy.challengesDesc: Handling state synchronization across mentor session scheduling while preventing double bookings. Resolved via transactional row locks in MySQL and optimistic client UI updates.
